finalText: All 12 remaining call sites are migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. The only leftover `db.query` is in `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which is explicitly marked as a vendored file that's replaced wholesale on upgrade — I left that alone rather than editing code that isn't ours to maintain. Note the `cache.query` calls in several files are a separate, unrelated API and weren't touched.
